title_en: Ḥadīth Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 27
entries.isnad_ar: أَخْبَرَنَا الشَّيْخُ الْإِمَامُ الْعَالِمُ الْعَلَّامَةُ ،
entries.matn_ar: قَاضِي الْقُضَاةِ ، شَيْخُ الْإِسْلَامِ ، حَافِظُ الْعَصْرِ ، نَادِرَةُ الدَّهْرِ: أَبُو الْفَضْلِ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْمُودٍ الْعَسْقَلَانِيُّ الشَّافِعِيُّ الشَّهِيرُ بِابْنِ حَجَرٍ قِرَاءَةُ عَلَيْهِ ، وَنَحْنُ نَسْمَعُ نَهَارَ السَّبْتِ يَوْمَ تَاسِعَ عَشَرَ شَهْرِ شَوَّالٍ سَنَةَ خَمْسِينَ وَثَمَانِمِائَةٍ قَالَ: أَنا الشَّيْخُ الْإِمَامُ الْمُسْنِدُ، أَبُو مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنِ ذِي النُّونِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْغَفَّارِ الصُّرَدِيُّ فِيمَا قَرَأَتْهُ عَلَيْهِ ، أَنا أَبُو الْحَسَنِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْوَانِيُّ: أَنا أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَكِّيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الطَّرَابُلْسِيُّ، أَنَا جَدِّي لِأُمِّي الْحَافِظُ أَبُو طَاهِرٍ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ السِّلَفِيُّ، أَنا أَبُو الْحَسَنِ مَكِّيُّ بْنُ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلَّانَ الْكَرْجِيُّ، أَنا أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ الْحَرْشِيُّ الْحِيرِيُّ، ثَنَا أَبُو الْعَبَّاسِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يُوسُفَ الْأَصَمُّ 1 - ، ثَنَا أَبُو يُحْيَى زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَسَدٍ الْمَرْوَزِيُّ: ثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَرْبُوعٍ، عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ الْحُوَيْرِثِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ رضي الله عنه عَلَى قُزَحٍ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ " ⦗ص: 29⦘ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ.. أَصْبِحُوا.. أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ.. أَصْبِحُوا.. ثُمَّ دَفَعَ إِلَيَّ لِأَنْظُرَ فَخِذِهِ قَدِ انْكَشَفَ مِمَّا يَخْرِشُ بَعِيرَهُ بِمِحْجَنِهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Informed us the Shaykh, the Imam, the scholar, the 'allama, the chief judge, Shaykh of Islam, hafiz of the age, rarity of the era:
entries.matn_en: Abu al-Fadl Ahmad b. 'Ali b. Muhammad b. Muhammad b. 'Ali b. Mahmud al-'Asqalani al-Shafi'i, famous as Ibn Hajar, by reading aloud to him while we listened, on Saturday, the nineteenth of the month of Shawwal, in the year 850 AH. He said: Informed us the Shaykh, the Imam, the musnid, Abu Muhammad 'Abd al-Wahid b. Dhi al-Nun b. 'Abd al-Ghaffar al-Suradi, in what I read to him: informed us Abu al-Hasan 'Ali b. 'Umar b. Abi Bakr al-Wani: informed us Abu al-Qasim 'Abd al-Rahman b. Makki b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Sa'id al-Tarabulusi: informed us my maternal grandfather, al-Hafiz Abu Tahir Ahmad b. Muhammad al-Silafi: informed us Abu al-Hasan Makki b. Mansur b. Muhammad b. 'Allan al-Karaji: informed us Abu Bakr Ahmad b. al-Hasan al-Harashi al-Hiri: narrated to us Abu al-'Abbas Muhammad b. Ya'qub b. Yusuf al-Asamm 1 -, narrated to us Abu Yahya Zakariyya b. Yahya b. Asad al-Marwazi: narrated to us Sufyan b. 'Uyayna, from Ibn al-Munkadir, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Yarbu', from Jubayr b. al-Huwayrith, who said: I saw Abu Bakr ﵁ at Quzah, and he was saying: “⦗p. 29⦘ O people… enter the morning… O people… enter the morning…” Then he moved forward toward me, so that I looked at his thigh, which had become uncovered as he was prodding his camel with his hooked staff (mihjan).

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 31
entries.isnad_ar: ثَنَا أَبُو يَحْيَى: ثَنَا سُفَيْانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ،
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعَ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَتْنَا عَائِشَةُ أَنَّ رَجُلًا، اسْتَأْذَنَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ: " ائْذَنُوا لَهُ فَبِئْسَ رَجُلُ الْعَشِيرِةِ أَوْ بِئْسَ ابْنُ الْعَشِيرَةِ، فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ أَلَانَ لَهُ الْقَوْلَ، فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قُلْتَ لَهُ الَّذِي قُلْتَ فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ أَلَنْتَ لَهُ الْقَوْلَ قَالَ: " يَا عَائِشَةُ إِنَّ " شَرَّ النَّاسِ مَنْزِلَةً يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ، مَنْ وَدَعَهُ أَوْ تَرَكَهُ النَّاسُ اتِّقَاءَ فُحْشِهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Yahya narrated to us: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, from Ibn al-Munkadir,
entries.matn_en: that he heard 'Urwa b. al-Zubayr say: 'A'isha narrated to us that a man asked permission to enter upon the Prophet ﷺ, and he said: “Let him in. What an evil man of the clan — or: what an evil son of the clan.” When he entered upon him, he spoke gently to him. 'A'isha said: “O Messenger of God, you said to him what you said, and when he entered, you spoke gently to him.” He said: “O 'A'isha, the worst of people in rank on the Day of Resurrection is the one whom people leave, or abandon, to guard against his obscenity.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 33
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، سَمِعَ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، يَقُولُ
entries.matn_ar: " إِذَا رَمَيْتَ الْجَمْرَةَ يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ فَقَدْ حَلَّ لَكَ مَا وَرَاءَ النِّسَاءِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ibn al-Munkadir, that he heard Ibn al-Zubayr say:
entries.matn_en: “When you have cast the pebbles at the Jamra on the Day of Sacrifice, then what lies beyond women has become lawful for you.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 35
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ،
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعَ جَابِرًا، يَقُولُ وُلِدَ لِرَجُلٍ مِنَّا غُلَامٌ، فَسَمَّاهُ الْقَاسِمَ فَقُلْنَا لَا نُكَنِّيكَ أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ وَلَا نُنْعِمُكَ عَيْنًا، فَأَتَيْنَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، فَذَكَرنَا لَهُ ذَلِكَ، فَقَالَ: " ابْنَكَ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, from Ibn al-Munkadir,
entries.matn_en: that he heard Jabir say: A boy was born to a man among us, and he named him al-Qasim. We said: “We will not give you the kunya Abu al-Qasim, and we will not delight your eye.” So we went to the Prophet ﷺ and mentioned that to him, and he said: “[Name] your son 'Abd al-Rahman.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 36
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِيَمِينِهِ، وَإِذَا شَرِبَ فَلْيَشْرَبْ بِيَمِينِهِ، فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَأْكُلُ بِشِمَالِهِ وَيَشْرَبُ بِشِمَالِهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Bakr b. 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Abd Allah, from his grandfather 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “When one of you eats, let him eat with his right hand, and when he drinks, let him drink with his right hand, for Satan eats with his left hand and drinks with his left hand.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 37
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ سَقَطَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ فَرَسٍ فَجُحِشَ شِقُّهُ الْأَيْمَنُ فَدَخَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ نَعُودُهُ فَحَضَرَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَصَلَّى قَاعِدًا فَصَلَّيْنَا قُعُودًا ، فَلَمَّا قَضَى الصَّلَاةَ، قَالَ: " إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الْإِمَامُ لِيُؤْتَمَّ بِهِ، فَإِذَا كَبَّرَ فَكَبِّرُوا، وَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَارْكَعُوا، وَإِذَا رَفَعَ فَارْفَعُوا، وَإِذَا قَالَ سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ، فَقُولُوا رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، وَإِذَا سَجَدَ فَاسْجُدُوا، وَإِذَا صَلَّى قَاعِدًا فَصَلُّوا قُعُودًا أَجْمَعِينَ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Anas b. Malik, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ fell from a horse and his right side was scraped. We entered upon him to visit him, and the time of prayer came, so he prayed sitting, and we prayed sitting. When he had completed the prayer, he said: “The imam is appointed only to be followed. So when he says the takbir, say the takbir; when he bows, bow; when he rises, rise; when he says ‘God hears whoever praises Him,’ say ‘Our Lord, and to You belongs praise’; when he prostrates, prostrate; and when he prays sitting, pray sitting, all of you.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 41
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزَّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدٍ الْقَارِيِّ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: " مَا بَالُ أَقْوَامٍ يَنْحَلُونَ أَوْلَادَهُمْ نُحْلَةً، فَإِذَا مَاتَ أَحَدُهُمْ قَالَ مَالِي وَفِي يَدَيَّ، وَإِذَا مَاتَ هُوَ قَالَ: كُنْتُ نَحَلْتُهُ وَلَدِي، لَا نِحْلَةَ إِلَّا نِحْلَةً يَحُوزُهَا الْوَلَدُ دُونَ الْوَالِدِ فَإِنْ مَاتَ وَرِثَهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Urwa b. al-Zubayr, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Abd al-Qari, that
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ said: “What is the matter with people who give their children a gift (nuhla), and when one of them dies, he says, ‘My property is in my hands,’ and when he himself dies, he says, ‘I had given it to my child’? There is no gift except a gift that the child takes into possession, apart from the father; and if he dies, he inherits from him.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 41
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ،:
entries.matn_ar: فَشُكِيَ ذَلِكَ إِلَى عُثْمَانَ فَرَأَى أَنَّ " الْوَالِدَ يَحُوزُ لِوَلَدِهِ إِذَا كَانُوا صِغَارًا "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab:
entries.matn_en: and this was complained of to 'Uthman, who was of the view that “a father may take possession on behalf of his child when they are young.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 41
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " إِذَا رَأَيْتُمُ الْجِنَازَةَ فَقُومُوا لَهَا حَتَّى تُخَلِّفَكُمْ أَوْ تُوضَعَ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, from his father, from 'Amir b. Rabi'a, that
entries.matn_en: the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “When you see a funeral procession, stand for it until it has passed you or has been set down.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 42
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ رَأَى أَبَاهُ يُصَلِّي الضُّحَى وَلَمْ يَكُنْ صَلَّى الضُّحَى قَالَ لَهُ: مَا هَذِهِ الصَّلَاةُ؟ فَقَالَ لَهُ " إِنِّي كُنْتُ مَسَسْتُ فَرْجِي وَلَمْ أَكُنْ أَتَوَضَّأ فَأَعَدْتُ الصَّلَاةَ وَهِيَ هَذِهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, that
entries.matn_en: he saw his father praying the forenoon prayer (duha), though he had not prayed the duha [before]. He said to him: “What is this prayer?” He said to him: “I had touched my private part and had not performed ablution, so I repeated the prayer, and this is it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 43
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْفِطْرَةُ خَمْسٌ أَوْ خَمْسٌ مِنَ الْفِطْرَةِ الْخِتَانُ، وَالِاسْتِحْدَادُ وَنَتْفُ الْإِبْطِ، وَقَصُّ الشَّارِبِ، وَتَقْلِيمُ الْأَظَافِرِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id, from Abu Hurayra, tracing it to the Prophet ﷺ, that
entries.matn_en: he said: “Five things are of the natural disposition (fitra) — or: five are from the natural disposition: circumcision, shaving the pubic hair, plucking the armpit hair, trimming the moustache, and clipping the nails.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 45
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَجُلٌ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَتَى السَّاعَةُ؟ قَالَ: " مَا أَعْدَدْتَ لَهَا؟ " فَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ كَبِيرًا إِلَّا أَنَّهُ يُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ، قَالَ: " فَأَنْتَ مَعَ مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Anas b. Malik, who said:
entries.matn_en: A man said: “O Messenger of God, when is the Hour?” He said: “What have you prepared for it?” He did not mention anything significant, except that he loves God and His Messenger. He said: “Then you are with those whom you love.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 46
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عَمْرٌو، سَمِعَ عُبَيْدَ بْنَ عُمَيْرٍ، يَقُولُ: قَالَ رَجُلٌ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ رَجُلٌ يُحِبُّ الْمُصَلِّينَ وَلَا يُصَلِّي إِلَّا قَلِيلًا، وَيُحِبُّ الصَّائِمِينَ وَلَا يَصُومُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا، وَيُحِبُّ الذَّاكِرِينَ وَلَا يَذْكُرُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا، وَيُحِبُّ الْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ وَلَا يَتَصَدَّقُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا، وَيُحِبُّ الْمُجَاهِدِينَ وَلَا يُجَاهِدُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا، وَهُوَ فِي ذَلِكَ يُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَالْمُؤْمِنِينَ قَالَ: " هُوَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَعَ مَنْ أَحَبَّ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us;
entries.matn_en: 'Amr said: he heard 'Ubayd b. 'Umayr say: A man said: “O Messenger of God, a man loves those who pray but prays only little, loves those who fast but fasts only little, loves those who remember [God] but remembers only little, loves those who give charity but gives only little, loves those who strive in God’s cause but strives only little, and in all this he loves God, His Messenger, and the believers.” He said: “On the Day of Resurrection he will be with those whom he loves.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 46
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ مَرِضَ عَامَ الْفَتْحِ مَرَضًا أَشْفَى مِنْهُ عَلَى الْمَوْتِ، فَأَتَاهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعُودُهُ وَهُوَ بِمَكَّةَ فَقَالَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ لِي مَالًا كَثِيرًا وَلَيْسَ يَرِثُنِي إِلَّا ابْنَتِي أَفَأَتَصَدَّقُ بِثُلُثَيْ مَالِي؟ قَالَ: " لَا " قَالَ: فَبِالشَّطْرِ؟ قَالَ: " لَا " قَالَ: فَبِالثُّلُثِ قَالَ: " الثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ إِنَّكَ إِنْ تَتْرُكْ وَرَثَتَكَ أَغْنِيَاءَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَتْرُكَهُمْ عَالَةً يَتَكَفَّفُونَ النَّاسَ، إِنَّكَ لَنْ تُنْفِقَ نَفَقَةً إِلَّا أُجِرْتَ فِيهَا حَتَّى اللُّقْمَةَ تَرْفَعُهَا إِلَى فِي امْرَأَتِكَ " قُلْتُ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أُخَلَّفُ عَنْ هِجْرَتِي؟ قَالَ: " إِنَّكَ لَنْ تُخَلَّفَ بَعْدِي فَتَعْمَلَ عَمَلًا تُرِيدُ بِهِ وَجْهَ اللَّهِ إِلَّا ازْدَدْتَ بِهِ رِفْعَةً وَدَرَجَةً، وَلَعَلَّكَ أَنْ تُخَلَّفَ حَتَّى يَنْتَفِعَ بِكَ أَقْوَامٌ وَيُضَرَّ بِكَ آخَرُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ ⦗ص: 47⦘ أَمْضِ لِأَصْحَابِي هِجْرَتَهُمْ وَلَا تَرُدَّهُمْ عَلَى أَعْقَابِهِمْ لَكِنِ الْبَائِسُ سَعْدُ بْنُ خَوْلَةَ يَرْثِي لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ مَاتَ بِمَكَّةَ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from 'Amir b. Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas, that
entries.matn_en: his father informed him that he fell ill in the year of the Conquest with an illness that brought him to the brink of death, so the Prophet ﷺ came to visit him while he was in Mecca. He said: “O Messenger of God, I have much wealth and none inherits from me except my daughter. May I give two-thirds of my wealth in charity?” He said: “No.” He said: “Then half?” He said: “No.” He said: “Then a third?” He said: “A third is a lot. For you to leave your heirs wealthy is better than that you leave them dependent, begging from people. You will not spend any expenditure but you will be rewarded for it, even the morsel that you raise to your wife’s mouth.” I said: “O Messenger of God, shall I be left behind from my hijra?” He said: “You will not be left behind after me and perform a deed seeking by it the face of God, but you will increase thereby in elevation and rank; and perhaps you will be left behind until people benefit from you and others are harmed by you. O God, ⦗p. 47⦘ complete for my Companions their hijra, and do not turn them back on their heels. But the wretched one is Sa'd b. Khawla” — the Messenger of God ﷺ lamented for him that he died in Mecca.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 52
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَضَافَ نَاسًا مِنْ هُذَيْلٍ فَذَهَبَتْ جَارِيَةٌ مِنْهُمْ تَحْتَطِبُ، فَرَاوَدَهَا عَنْ نَفْسِهَا فَرَمَتْهُ بِحَجَرٍ فَقَتَلَتْهُ، فَرُفِعَ ذَلِكَ إِلَى عُمَرَ، فَقَالَ " ذَاكَ قَتِيلُ اللَّهِ، وَاللَّهِ لَا يُودَى ذَلِكَ أَبَدًا "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from al-Qasim b. Muhammad, from 'Ubayd b. 'Umayr, that
entries.matn_en: a man hosted some people of Hudhayl, and a slave girl of theirs went to gather firewood; he solicited her for himself, so she threw a stone at him and killed him. The matter was brought up to 'Umar, who said: “He is one slain by God. By God, no blood-money will ever be paid for him.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 52
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ نَافِعَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ، يُخْبِرُ عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْخُزَاعِيِّ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ: " مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيُحْسِنْ إِلَى جَارِهِ، مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَسْكُتْ، وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Amr,
entries.matn_en: that he heard Nafi' b. Jubayr reporting from Abu Shurayh al-Khuza'i that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Whoever believes in God and the Last Day, let him be good to his neighbor. Whoever believes in God and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent. And whoever believes in God and the Last Day, let him honor his guest.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 52
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ سُفَيْانُ، وَزَادَ ابْنُ عَجْلَانَ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي شُرَيْحٍ الْخُزَاعِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: ⦗ص: 53⦘ " مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ، وَجَائِزَتُهُ يَوْمُهُ وَلَيْلَتُهُ، وَالضِّيَافَةُ ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ، وَلَا يَحِلُّ لَهُ أَنْ يَثْوِيَ عِنْدَهُ حَتَّى يُحْرِجَهُ فَمَا أَنْفَقَ عَلَيْهِ بَعْدَ ثَلَاثٍ فَهُوَ صَدَقَةٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan said: Ibn 'Ajlan added, from Ibn Abi Sa'id, from his father, from Abu Shurayh al-Khuza'i, from the Prophet ﷺ:
entries.matn_en: ⦗p. 53⦘ “Whoever believes in God and the Last Day, let him honor his guest; his due (ja'iza) is a day and a night; hospitality is three days; and it is not lawful for him [the guest] to stay with him until he puts him in difficulty. Whatever he spends on him after three [days] is charity.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 53
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَبَّاسِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَر،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ حَاصَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَهْلَ الطَّائِفِ فَلَمْ يَنَلْ مِنْهُمْ شَيْئًا فَقَالَ: " إِنَّا قَافِلُونَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ " قَالَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ: أَنَرْجِعُ وَلَمْ نَفْتَحْ؟، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: " فَاغْدُوا عَلَى الْقِتَالِ غَدًا فَأَصَابَهُمْ جِرَاحٌ، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم: " إِنَّا قَافِلُونَ غَدًا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ " فَأَعْجَبَهُمْ ذَلِكَ فَضَحِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Amr, from Abu al-'Abbas, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ besieged the people of al-Ta'if and gained nothing from them. He said: “We are returning, God willing.” The Muslims said: “Shall we return without having conquered?” The Messenger of God ﷺ said to them: “Then go out to the fight early tomorrow.” They suffered wounds. Then the Messenger of God ﷺ said to them: “We are returning tomorrow, God willing.” That pleased them, and the Messenger of God ﷺ laughed.

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 54
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ وَاللَّهِ " مَا أُمُّ وَلَدِكَ إِلَّا بِمَنْزِلَةِ شَاتِكَ أَوْ بَعِيرِكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Amr, from 'Ata', from Ibn 'Abbas, who said:
entries.matn_en: “By God, your umm walad [a slave woman who has borne you a child] is nothing but in the position of your sheep or your camel.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 54
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ عَبْدَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعَ أَبَا وَائِلٍ، يَقُولُ كَثِيرًا: كُنْتُ أَذْهَبُ أَنَا وَمَسْرُوقٌ، إِلَى الصُّبَيِّ بْنِ مَعْبَدٍ نَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ، وَكَانَ رَجُلًا نَصْرَانِيًّا مِنْ بَنِي تَغْلِبَ فَأَسْلَمَ فَحَجَّ فَسَمِعَهُ سَلْمَانُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ الْبَاهِلِيُّ، وَزَيْدُ بْنُ صُوحَانَ، وَهُوَ يُهِلُّ بِالْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ بِالْفَارِسِيَّةِ فَقَالَا: هَذَا أَضَلُّ مِنْ بَعِيرِ أَهْلِهِ، قَالَ: فَكَأَنَّمَا حُمِلَ عَلَيَّ بِكَلَامِهِمَا جَبَلٌ حَتَّى أَتَيْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رضي الله عنه، فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهِمَا وَلَامَهُمَا ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيَّ، فَقَالَ " هُدِيتَ لِسُنَّةِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abda,
entries.matn_en: that he heard Abu Wa'il say often: I used to go, I and Masruq, to al-Subayy b. Ma'bad to ask him about this hadith. He was a Christian man of Banu Taghlib who converted to Islam, then performed hajj. Salman b. Rabi'a al-Bahili and Zayd b. Suhan heard him while he was pronouncing the talbiya for hajj and 'umra in Persian, and they said: “This man is more astray than the camel of his family.” He said: It was as though a mountain had been placed upon me by their words, until I came to 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ and mentioned that. He turned to the two of them and rebuked them, then turned to me and said: “You have been guided to the Sunna of the Prophet ﷺ.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 55
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ عَبْدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَمَقْتُ ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ فَرَأَيْتُهُ " يَنْهَضُ عَلَى صُدُورِ قَدَمَيْهِ وَلَا يَجْلِسُ فِي أَوَّلِ رَكْعَةٍ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَ سُجُودَهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abda, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid, who said:
entries.matn_en: I watched Ibn Mas'ud closely and saw him “rise upon the fronts of his feet, and not sit in the first rak'a until he had completed his prostration.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 56
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سِبَاعِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، سَمِعَ أُمَّ كُرْزٍ الْكَعْبِيَّةَ، تَقُولُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: " أَقِرُّوا الطَّيْرَ عَلَى مَكِنَاتِهَا "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Ubayd Allah b. Abi Yazid, from his father, from Siba' b. Thabit, who heard Umm Kurz al-Ka'biyya say:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: “Leave the birds in their nesting places.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 57
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم: " الْوَلَدُ لِلْفِرَاشِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Ubayd Allah b. Abi Yazid, from his father, who heard 'Umar b. al-Khattab say: The Prophet ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “The child belongs to the bed (al-firash).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 58
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلَانَ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْأَشَجِّ، عَنْ مَعْمَرِ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَدِيِّ بْنِ الْخِيَارِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، رضي الله عنه يَقُولُ
entries.matn_ar: " إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا تَوَاضَعَ لِلَّهِ رَفَعَ اللهُ حَكَمَتَهُ، وَقَالَ انْتَعِشْ رَفَعَكَ اللَّهُ فَهُوَ فِي نَفْسِهِ حَقِيرٌ، وَفِي أَعْيُنِ النَّاسِ كَبِيرٌ، وَإِذَا تَكَبَّرَ وَعَدَا طَوْرَهُ وَهَصَهُ اللهُ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ وَقَالَ اخْسَأْ أَخْسَأَكَ اللَّهُ، فَهُوَ فِي نَفْسِهِ كَبِيرٌ وَفِي أَعْيُنِ النَّاسِ حَقِيرٌ حَتَّى إِنَّهُ أَحْقَرُ فِي أَعْيُنِهِمْ مِنَ الْخِنْزِيرِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ لَا تُبَغِّضُوا اللَّهَ إِلَى عِبَادِهِ قَالَ قَائِلٌ: وَكَيْفَ ذَلِكَ أَصْلَحَكَ اللَّهُ؟ قَالَ يَكُونُ أَحَدُكُمْ إِمَامًا فَيُطَوِّلُ عَلَى النَّاسِ فَيُبَغِّضُ إِلَيْهِمْ مَا هُمْ فِيهِ، وَيَقْعُدُ قَاصًّا فَيُطَوِّلُ عَلَيْهِمْ حَتَّى يُبَغِّضَ إِلَيْهِمْ مَا هُمْ فِيهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Muhammad b. 'Ajlan, from Bukayr b. 'Abd Allah b. al-Ashajj, from Ma'mar b. Abi Habiba, from 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Adi b. al-Khiyar, who said: I heard 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ say:
entries.matn_en: “When a servant humbles himself for God, God raises his hakama and says, ‘Be lifted up; God has lifted you up,’ so he is lowly in his own eyes and great in the eyes of people. But when he acts arrogantly and exceeds his bounds, God dashes him to the ground and says, ‘Be gone; God has abased you,’ so he is great in his own eyes and lowly in the eyes of people, until he is lower in their eyes than a pig. Then he said: ‘O people, do not make God hateful to His servants.’ Someone said: ‘And how is that, may God set you right?’ He said: ‘One of you is an imam and lengthens [the prayer] for the people, so that what they are engaged in becomes hateful to them; and he sits as a storyteller and lengthens it for them until what they are engaged in becomes hateful to them.’”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 59
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَصَابَ امْرَأَتَهُ حَلَالًا قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: " نَعَمْ، ذَاكَ حِينَ أَصَابَ الْحَلَالَ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Ubayd Allah:
entries.matn_en: I asked Ibn 'Abbas about a man who had relations with his wife while in a lawful state (halalan). He said: “Yes; that is when he has come upon what is lawful.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 59
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ ⦗ص: 60⦘ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، يَقُولُ إِنَّمَا " جَمَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ الْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ لِأَنَّهُ عَلِمَ أَنَّهُ لَا يَحُجُّ بَعْدَهَا "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Isma'il b. Abi Khalid,
entries.matn_en: that he heard 'Abd Allah b. ⦗p. 60⦘ Abi Qatada say: “The Prophet ﷺ combined hajj and 'umra only because he knew that he would not perform hajj after it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 61
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ مُصْعَبٍ، سَمِعَ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم "
entries.matn_ar: يُهِلُّ بِالْحَجِّ وَالْعُمْرَةِ جَمِيعًا "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Mus'ab,
entries.matn_en: that he heard Anas say: I heard the Prophet ﷺ “pronouncing the talbiya for hajj and 'umra together.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 61
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: سَأَلْتُ أُمَّ الدَّرْدَاءِ عَنِ الْعُمْرَةِ بَعْدَ الْحَجِّ الشَّكُّ مِنِّي فَأَمَرَتْنِي بِهَا "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Walid b. Hisham, who said:
entries.matn_en: I asked Umm al-Darda' about 'umra after hajj — the uncertainty is mine — and she commanded me to do it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 61
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " قَالَ اللَّهُ يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ " أَنْفِقْ أُنْفِقْ عَلَيْكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayra,
entries.matn_en: tracing it to the Prophet ﷺ, who said: “God said: ‘O son of Adam, spend, and I will spend on you.’”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 61
entries.matn_ar: وَقَالَ: " يَمِينُ اللَّهِ مَلْأَى سَحَّاءُ لَا يُنْقِصُهَا شَيْءٌ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ "
entries.matn_en: And he said: “The right hand of God is full, ever-flowing; nothing diminishes it, night or day.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 61
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: يَقُولُ قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ: " ⦗ص: 62⦘ سَمُّوا بِاسْمِي وَلَا تَكْتَنُوا بِكُنْيَتِي "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ayyub, from Muhammad b. Sirin: I heard Abu Hurayra say:
entries.matn_en: Abu al-Qasim said: “⦗p. 62⦘ Name yourselves with my name, but do not adopt my kunya.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 64
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْأَحْوَصِ الْأَزْدِيِّ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، قَالَتْ: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَهُوَ فِي بَطْنِ الْوَادِي وَهُوَ يَرْمِي الْجَمْرَةَ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: " يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ لَا يَقْتُلُ بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا إِذَا رَمَيْتُمُ الْجَمْرَةَ فَارْمُوا بِمِثْلِ حَصَى الْخَذْفِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Yazid b. Abi Ziyad, from Sulayman b. 'Amr b. al-Ahwas al-Azdi, from his mother, who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard the Prophet ﷺ, while he was in the bottom of the valley casting pebbles at the Jamra, saying: “O people, do not kill one another. When you cast pebbles at the Jamra, cast with pebbles like those used for flicking (hasa al-khadhf).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 64
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ عَطَاءٌ: " رَمْيُ الْجِمَارِ رُكُوبُ يَوْمَيْنِ وَمَشْيُ يَوْمَيْنِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ibrahim b. Nafi', from Ibn Abi Najih, who said:
entries.matn_en: 'Ata' said: “Casting the pebbles is riding for two days and walking for two days.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 64
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الْأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَلِّمُ النَّاسَ مَنَاسِكَهُمْ وَقَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " ارْمُوا الْجِمَارَ بِمِثْلِ حَصَى الْخَذْفِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Humayd al-A'raj, from Muhammad b. Ibrahim al-Taymi, from a man of his people, who said:
entries.matn_en: I heard the Prophet ﷺ teaching people their rites of pilgrimage, and he said: “Cast the pebbles like pebbles used for flicking (hasa al-khadhf).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 65
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْبَيْدَاءِ وَأَنَا رَدِيفُ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، " يُهِلُّ بِالْعُمْرَةِ وَالْحَجِّ جَمِيعًا "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Humayd al-Tawil, from Anas b. Malik,
entries.matn_en: that he heard the Prophet ﷺ at al-Bayda' while I was riding behind Abu Talha, “pronouncing the talbiya for 'umra and hajj together.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 65
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ خَلَّفَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى سَعْدٍ رَجُلًا فَقَالَ: " إِنْ مَاتَ فَلَا تَدْفِنُوهُ بِهَا "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Isma'il b. Muhammad, from 'Abd al-Rahman, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ left a man behind with Sa'd, and said: “If he dies, do not bury him in it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 65
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ قَالَ سَعْدٌ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم " أَتَكْرَهُ لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ يَمُوتَ بِالْأَرْضِ الَّتِي هَاجَرَ مِنْهَا قَالَ: " نَعَمْ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Qays, from Abu Burda, who said:
entries.matn_en: Sa'd said to the Prophet ﷺ: “Do you dislike for a man to die in the land from which he emigrated?” He said: “Yes.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 65
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ بِشْرِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، رضي الله عنه اسْتَعْمَلَ أَبَاهُ عَلَى الطَّائِفِ وَمَخَالفِيْهَا فَخَرَجَ يُصَدِّقُ فَاعْتَدَّ بِالْغِذَاءِ وَلَمْ يَأْخُذِ مِنْهُمُ الْغِذَاءَ، فَقَالَ النَّاسُ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْتَدُّهَا فَخُذْهَا مِنَّا فَأَمْسَكَ حَتَّى لَقِيَ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ: " اعْتَدَّ بِالْغِذَاءِ حَتَّى بِالسَّخْلَةِ يَرُوحُ بِهَا الرَّاعِي عَلَى يَدَيْهِ، وَقُلْ لَهُمْ: إِنِّي لَا آخُذُ مِنْكُمُ الرُّبَّى وَالْمَاخِضَ وَلَا الشَّاةَ الْأَكُولَةَ وَلَا فَحْلَ الْغَنَمِ وَخُذِ الْعَنَاقَ وَالْجَذَعَةَ وَالثَّنِيَّةَ فَذَاكَ عَدْلٌ بَيْنَ غَذِيِّ الْمَالِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Bishr b. 'Asim, from his father, that
entries.matn_en: 'Umar b. al-Khattab ﵁ appointed his father over al-Ta'if and its outlying districts, so he went out to collect the alms-tax, and he counted the suckling young but did not take the suckling young from them. The people said: “If you count them, then take them from us.” So he held back until he met 'Umar b. al-Khattab, and 'Umar said to him: “Count the suckling young, even the lamb that the shepherd brings home in the evening carried on his arms, and say to them: ‘I will not take from you the nursing ewe, the ewe about to give birth, the ewe fattened for eating, or the stud ram of the flock; but take the young she-goat ('anaq), the jadha'a, and the thaniyya; for that is fair between the young of the flock.’”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 66
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، ثَنَا جَامِعِ بْنِ أَبِي رَاشِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا كَتَبَ إِلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ يُحَرِّجُ عَلَيْهَا فِي حَقٍّ لَهُ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ " أَنْ يُجْلَدَ ثَلَاثِينَ جَلْدَةً "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us; Jami' b. Abi Rashid narrated to us, from Abu Wa'il, that
entries.matn_en: a man wrote to Umm Salama, pressing her regarding a right of his, so 'Umar b. al-Khattab ordered that he “be flogged thirty lashes.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 66
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي الْبَدَّاحِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم " رَخَّصَ لِلرِّعَاءِ أَنْ يَرْمُوا يَوْمًا وَيَدَعُوا يَوْمًا "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. Abi Bakr, from his father, from Abu al-Baddah b. 'Adi, from his father, that
entries.matn_en: the Prophet ﷺ “granted a concession to the herdsmen to cast [pebbles] one day and leave off one day.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 68
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ أَبِي السَّوْدَاءِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: تَقَدَّمَ هُوَ وَأَخُوهُ إِلَى شُرَيْحٍ فَسَأَلُوهُ عَنْ سَلَمٍ أَسْلَمُوهُ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ أَصْحَابُهُ: خُذْ مِنَّا بَعْضَ سَلَمِكَ وَبَعْضَ رَأْسِ مَالِكَ فَسَأَلُوا شُرَيْحًا، فَقَالَ " إِمَّا أَنْ تَأْخُذُوا رَأْسَ مَالِكُمْ جَمِيعًا أَوْ سَلَمَكُمْ جَمِيعًا "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu al-Sawda', who said:
entries.matn_en: He and his brother went forward to Shurayh and asked him about a salam [advance-payment sale] that they had contracted. His companions said to them: “Take from us some of your salam and some of your capital.” So they asked Shurayh, who said: “Either you take all of your capital, or all of your salam.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 68
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: " إِذَا أَسْلَمْتَ فِي شَيْءٍ فَلَا بَأْسَ بِهِ أَنْ تَأْخُذَ بَعْضَ سَلَمِكَ وَبَعْضَ رَأْسِ مَالِكَ فَذَاكَ الْمَعْرُوفُ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Salama b. Musa, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said:
entries.matn_en: “If you have made a salam contract for something, there is no harm in your taking some of your salam and some of your capital; that is what is customary.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 68
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ
entries.matn_ar: " ⦗ص: 69⦘ إِذَا أَسْلَمْتَ فِي شَيْءٍ فَلَا تَأْخُذْ إِلَّا الَّذِي أَسْلَمْتَ أَوْ رَأْسَ مَالِكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Amr, from Jabir b. Zayd, who said:
entries.matn_en: “⦗p. 69⦘ If you have made a salam contract for something, take only that for which you contracted, or your capital.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 69
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الْأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " إِذَا نَظَرَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى مَنْ فُضِّلَ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْجِسْمِ فَلْيَنْظُرْ إِلَى مَنْ دُونَهُ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْجِسْمِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayra,
entries.matn_en: tracing it to the Prophet ﷺ, who said: “When one of you looks at someone who has been favored over him in wealth and physique, let him look at someone beneath him in wealth and physique.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 70
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي حَفْصَةَ، عَنْ مُنْذِرٍ الثَّوْرِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَرَأَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ ابْنِ الْحَنَفِيَّةِ هَلْ جَزَاءُ الْإِحْسَانِ إِلَّا الْإِحْسَانُ قَالَ " هِيَ مُسَجَّلَةٌ لِلْبَرِّ وَالْفَاجِرِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Salim b. Abi Hafsa, from Mundhir al-Thawri, who said: Muhammad b. 'Ali Ibn al-Hanafiyya recited:
entries.matn_en: “Is the reward for goodness anything but goodness?” He said: “It is made general (musajjala) for the righteous and the wicked.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 70
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلَاقَةَ، سَمِعَ جَرِيرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ
entries.matn_ar: " بَايَعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى النُّصْحِ لِكُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Ziyad b. 'Ilaqa, who heard Jarir b. 'Abd Allah say:
entries.matn_en: “I pledged allegiance to the Prophet ﷺ to give sincere counsel to every Muslim.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 72
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي مُسْلِمٍ الْأَحْوَلِ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ كُنَّا بِمَكَّةَ وَمَعَنَا مِقْسَمٌ وَأَنَا مَعَ طَاوُسٍ فَجَعَلَ يُحَدِّثُ مِقْسَمٌ فَجَعَلَ طَاوُسٌ يَقُولُ: إِيهِ مِقْسَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ: يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ فَقَالَ " وَاللَّهِ لَا أُكَنِّيهِ بِهَا أَبَدًا "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Sulayman b. Abi Muslim al-Ahwal, who said:
entries.matn_en: We were in Mecca, and Miqsam was with us, and I was with Tawus. Miqsam began to narrate, and Tawus began to say: “Go on, Miqsam.” He said: I said: “O Abu 'Abd al-Rahman — Abu al-Qasim?” So he said: “By God, I will never give him that kunya.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 72
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ زِرِّ بْنِ حُبَيْشٍ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَسَّالٍ الْمُرَادِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَجُلٌ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ رَجُلًا أَحَبَّ قَوْمًا وَلَمَّا يَلْحَقْ بِهِمْ قَالَ: " هُوَ مَعَ مَنْ أَحَبَّ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from 'Asim, from Zirr b. Hubaysh, from Safwan b. 'Assal al-Muradi, who said:
entries.matn_en: A man said: “O Messenger of God, what do you say of a man who loves a people but has not yet joined them?” He said: “He is with whom he loves.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 73
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ،
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعَ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ: مَنْ قَالَ إِذَا أَخَذَ مَضْجَعَهُ: " اللَّهُمَّ إِلَيْكَ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَإِلَيْكَ وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي وَإِلَيْكَ فَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي وَإِلَيْكَ أَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَى مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ وَبِرَسُولِكَ أَوْ نَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ فَإِنْ مَاتَ مَاتَ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan narrated to us, from Abu Ishaq, who heard al-Bara' b. 'Azib say: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say:
entries.matn_en: Whoever says, when he takes to his bed: “O God, to You I have submitted myself, to You I have turned my face, to You I have entrusted my affair, and to You I have committed my back, in longing and in fear; there is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You have revealed, and in Your Messenger — or: Your Prophet — whom You have sent,” then if he dies, he dies upon the natural disposition (fitra).

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 73
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ يَنْزِلُ عَلَيْنَا بِمَكَّةَ " فَإِذَا أَنْفَقْنَا عَلَيْهِ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ أَبَى أَنْ يَقْبَلَ بَعْدُ "
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Wahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: al-Hasan b. Muhammad b. 'Ali used to stay with us in Mecca, “and when we had spent on him for three days, he refused to accept anything after that.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.citation: Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna · p. 74
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُفَيْانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَقِيَ رَجُلَانِ ابْنَ عُمَرَ فِي بَعْضِ طُرُقِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَا: تَرَكْنَا هَذَا الرَّجُلَ يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ يَبِيعُ أُمَّهَاتِ الْأَوْلَادِ فَقَالَ لَهُمَا: لَكِنَّ أَبَا حَفْصٍ عُمَرَ، أَتَعْرِفَانَهُ؟ قَالَا: نَعَمْ، " قَضَى فِي أُمَّهَاتِ الْأَوْلَادِ لَا يُبَعْنَ وَلَا يُهَبْنَ وَلَا يُوَرَّثْنَ يَسْتَمْتِعُ بِهَا صَاحِبُهَا مَا عَاشَ فَإِذَا مَاتَ فَهِيَ حُرَّةٌ " وَالْحَمْد لله وَحده، وَكَانَ الْفَرَاغ من كِتَابَة هَذَا الْجُزْء الْمُبَارك نَهَار الْخَمِيس يَوْم سَابِع ذِي الْحجَّة الْحَرَام من شهور سنة خمسين. .
entries.isnad_en: Sufyan b. 'Uyayna narrated to us, from 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Umar, from Nafi', who said:
entries.matn_en: Two men met Ibn 'Umar on one of the roads of Medina and said: “We have left this man” — they meant Ibn al-Zubayr — “selling umm walads.” He said to them: “But Abu Hafs 'Umar — do you know him?” They said: “Yes.” “He ruled regarding umm walads that they are not to be sold, nor given as gifts, nor inherited; their owner enjoys them as long as he lives, and when he dies, she is free.” Praise be to God alone. The writing of this blessed fascicle was completed on Thursday, the seventh of Dhu al-Hijja al-Haram, of the months of the year fifty. .
